primary.$description: Filled action color: main buttons, active indicator, selected-row edge. Ramp: primary 600.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.79:1 on primary, 8.02:1 on primary-hover.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of primary fills. Ramp: primary 700.

primary-container.$description: Selected rows and list items, quiet emphasis. Ramp: primary 100.

on-primary-container.$description: Text on primary-container. Ramp: primary 800. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.75:1 on primary-container.

secondary.$description: Neutral filled action (no second brand hue): toggled toolbar buttons, neutral badges. Ramp: neutral 700.

on-secondary.$description: Text on secondary. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 7.99:1 on secondary.

secondary-container.$description: Neutral fill: secondary buttons hover, filter chips, inactive segmented controls. Ramp: neutral 150.

on-secondary-container.$description: Text on secondary-container. Ramp: neutral 900. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 11.55:1 on secondary-container.

surface.$description: Page canvas behind everything. Ramp: neutral 100.

surface-raised.$description: Panels, tables, forms, cards on the canvas. Ramp: neutral 50.

surface-overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts (with the floating shadow). Ramp: neutral 50.

surface-hover.$description: Hover tint for table rows and list items. Ramp: primary 50.

on-surface.$description: Default text and icons on any surface layer. Ramp: neutral 900. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 13.62:1 on surface, 15.46:1 on surface-raised, 15.46:1 on surface-overlay, 15.55:1 on surface-hover.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text: metadata, column headers, timestamps, placeholders. Ramp: neutral 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.1:1 on surface, 5.79:1 on surface-raised, 5.79:1 on surface-overlay, 5.82:1 on surface-hover.

border.$description: Decorative dividers and panel outlines (not required to meet 3:1). Ramp: neutral 200.

border-strong.$description: Edges of controls that must be found: inputs, secondary buttons, unassigned chips. Ramp: neutral 450. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 3.14:1 on surface, 3.56:1 on surface-raised, 3.56:1 on surface-overlay.

border-focus.$description: 2px keyboard focus ring. Ramp: primary 500. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 3.69:1 on surface, 4.19:1 on surface-raised, 4.19:1 on surface-overlay, 4.21:1 on surface-hover.

link.$description: Inline text links (always underlined). Ramp: primary 650. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.03:1 on surface, 6.85:1 on surface-raised, 6.85:1 on surface-overlay.

error.$description: Error text/icons on surfaces; destructive button fill. Ramp: red 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.1:1 on surface, 5.79:1 on surface-raised, 5.79:1 on surface-overlay.

on-error.$description: Text on error fills. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.79:1 on error.

error-container.$description: Error banners and blocked-status chips. Ramp: red 100.

on-error-container.$description: Text on error-container. Ramp: red 800. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.82:1 on error-container.

warning.$description: Warning text/icons on surfaces (at-risk, late). Ramp: amber 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.13:1 on surface, 5.83:1 on surface-raised, 5.83:1 on surface-overlay.

on-warning.$description: Text on warning fills. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.83:1 on warning.

warning-container.$description: Warning banners and late-status chips. Ramp: amber 100.

on-warning-container.$description: Text on warning-container. Ramp: amber 800. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.83:1 on warning-container.

success.$description: Success text/icons on surfaces (done, on site, saved). Ramp: green 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.1:1 on surface, 5.8:1 on surface-raised, 5.8:1 on surface-overlay.

on-success.$description: Text on success fills. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.8:1 on success.

success-container.$description: Success banners and on-site/done chips. Ramp: green 100.

on-success-container.$description: Text on success-container. Ramp: green 800. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.8:1 on success-container.

info.$description: Info text/icons on surfaces (en route); must stay distinct from primary. Ramp: blue 650. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.99:1 on surface, 6.8:1 on surface-raised, 6.8:1 on surface-overlay.

on-info.$description: Text on info fills. Ramp: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.8:1 on info.

info-container.$description: Info banners and en-route chips. Ramp: blue 100.

on-info-container.$description: Text on info-container. Ramp: blue 800. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.8:1 on info-container.
